svg.title: Not yet: SPECTRA, SYNCHRO, AETHER
svg.desc: Plate V. Three names drawn only as sketches, because nothing public exists for them yet: SPECTRA, multimodal AI and computer vision; SYNCHRO, distributed systems and real-time; AETHER, creative computing and WebGL. Each has a dashed mark of its question. There is no ember and no ground: nothing here is lit, or printed, yet.
